Ishita Yadav
Senior Backend Engineer | Remote
ishita.yadav271@example.com | +91 9324862839

Experienced backend engineer focused on building scalable, resilient services with strong backend architecture and automation skills. Proven track record delivering microservices-based systems, improving performance, and reducing operational toil through tooling and process improvements. Available with a 15 days notice period.

Experience

Accenture, Oct 2022 - Present
Senior Backend Engineer — Remote
- Designed and implemented Microservices in Python, splitting a monolithic billing service into 6 independent services; reduced deployment time by 70% and improved fault isolation, decreasing incident blast radius by 60%.
- Built containerized service deployments using Docker and automated CI pipelines, cutting mean time to deploy from 4 hours to 30 minutes.
- Implemented Redis-backed caching and optimized PostgreSQL queries, improving average API latency by 45% and lowering DB load during peak periods by 35%.
- Integrated Celery for asynchronous job processing and moved long-running batch jobs off the request path, increasing system throughput by 50% and reducing user-facing timeouts.

Bluefin Logistics, Apr 2020 - Sep 2022
Backend Engineer — Remote
- Developed logistics APIs with FastAPI and Python to support real-time shipment tracking and routing; reduced API response times by 40% and supported a 3x increase in concurrent users.
- Designed PostgreSQL schemas and indexing strategies for high-cardinality tracking data, improving query performance and reducing average report generation time from 90s to 12s.
- Implemented Redis for ephemeral session and cache storage and introduced background processing with Celery to handle reconciliation tasks, cutting nightly processing windows by 65%.
- Containerized services with Docker and managed code via Git; authored Confluence runbooks and operational playbooks that reduced on-call escalations by 30%.

Projects

Real-time Shipment Monitor
- Built a prototype service combining FastAPI, Redis, and PostgreSQL to ingest and visualize shipment telemetry; supported simulated 10k events/min with median processing latency under 200ms.

Automated Reconciliation Worker
- Implemented a Celery-based worker in Python to reconcile transactional records against external partners, reducing manual reconciliation effort by ~80%.

Skills

Languages: Python
Frameworks/Stack: Django, FastAPI, Celery, Microservices
Datastores/Tools: PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Git
Other: Confluence, Linux

Education

M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad

Notice period: 15 days
